text:
Thank you for sharing your history; given your background with AIDS, I need to determine if you are experiencing an acute ocular infection or a systemic progression of your condition. Can you describe exactly when the vision loss and black spots started, and do you experience any pain, floaters, or flashes of light in your right eye?

REQUEST TEST: Ocular_Fundoscopy
REQUEST IMAGES: Fundus_Photograph_Right_Eye

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Granular yellow-white opacities around the retinal vessels and multiple areas of dot-blot hemorrhages

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis. The presence of granular yellow-white opacities with dot-blot hemorrhages in an AIDS patient is pathognomonic for this opportunistic infection. Please ensure you are on appropriate antiviral therapy and have your CD4 count checked immediately.
